_doc: GROWTH-TG-QUOTA-PARITY-W1 CH4 — the scan manifest for scripts/check-forbidden-phrases.mjs.
GLOB-DERIVED, exactly the shape ops/footer-coverage-config.json already uses — and for the
same reason it uses it. That config exists because a hand-listed TARGETS array went stale
TWICE, silently, while reporting success over pages it never opened. A hand-listed corpus
cannot distinguish 'clean' from 'never looked', so the only thing a human maintains here is
the far smaller set of paths that must NOT be scanned — each carrying its reason IN DATA.
An exemption that lives in a code comment gets 'fixed' by the next wave enforcing the
contract; one that lives here has to be argued with.
🛑 LEDGER PATHS ARE EXEMPT BY REASONED ENTRY, NEVER BY SILENT OMISSION. A dated Prompt/,
Old Status/, audits/ or CHANGELOG entry states what was true WHEN WRITTEN. Rewriting one
falsifies the record — Build Rule 5. The manifest exemption IS the record that they were
considered and deliberately left alone; nobody has to add a banner to 50 files.

exempt.reason: LEDGER. A dated audit records what was measured on its date; correcting a superseded figure inside one would make it a lie about its own moment. Build Rule 5.
LEDGER. Released-version entries are historical by construction — a v1.19 line saying `100 calls/month` is CORRECT about v1.19.
LEDGER. Explicitly archived content, preserved verbatim by the trim policy.

AMENDED, NOT REWRITTEN. This document deliberately keeps its retired rules struck through in place — the record of what it once asserted is the point — so it quotes the retired free-tier phrasing on purpose. GROWTH-TG-QUOTA-PARITY-W1 CH3g.
LEDGER. Records the pre-registered gates as they stood at decision time.
TEMPLATE SOURCE, not a served page — placeholders here are substituted by the generator before anything ships. Correcting the RENDERED output is what matters, and those pages are in the glob.

TEST FIXTURES. A test asserting that a retired phrase is REJECTED must be able to contain it; banning it here would make the guard's own coverage unwritable — the `exemption + its test are a pair` rule.

_vacuity_note: A manifest that expands to zero files is INDETERMINATE, never PASS. The corpus is CONSTRUCTED here, so empty means this file is wrong — not that the estate is clean.
